_comment: PLAGA '44 - Emersion Effects Configuration. All thresholds and tuning parameters externalized for designer iteration.
_issue: #31 - Audio system and VR emersion effects

heartbeat._comment_stress: Stress adds up to 60 BPM (scenario: combat, NPC encounters)
heartbeat._comment_exertion: Exertion adds up to 50 BPM (scenario: 25kg backpack marches)
heartbeat._comment_temperature: Temperature stress adds up to 30 BPM (scenario: hypothermia, heatstroke)
heartbeat._comment_dehydration: Dehydration adds up to 25 BPM (scenario: summer marches without water)

breathing._comment: Cold breath particles visible below 5C, matching scenario winter conditions

stressAudio._comment: Hallucinations at 80%+ mental health degradation, per scenario: 2+ weeks in survival causes breakdown

factorWeights._comment: Cold is primary tremor source (scenario: winter frostbite), fear secondary (adrenaline)

tunnelVision._comment: Radius of 0.3 = severe narrowing. Blood loss is primary cause.

blur._comment: Poisoning causes strongest blur (scenario: poisonous mushrooms in autumn)

desaturation._comment: Hypothermia is primary desaturation cause (world goes grey as body shuts down)

vignette._comment: Dark red vignette from blood loss

snowBlindness._comment: Scenario part 4: snow blindness risk without ballistic/sun glasses

hallucinations._comment: Shadow movement at extreme fatigue / mental health degradation

mild._comment: Shivering begins, cold hands, reduced dexterity

severe._comment: Paradoxical: shivering STOPS. Body shutting down. Death imminent.

hypothermia._comment: Teeth chattering only in mild-moderate range; stops at severe (body gives up)

heatHaze._comment: Heat haze starts at 30% dehydration, doubled in temperatures above 25C

dizziness._comment: Dizziness worse when moving (scenario: marching in summer heat)

blackout._comment: Blackout flashes above 80% dehydration. Scenario: fainting from heatstroke.

dehydration._comment_scenario: Summer: 2 glasses water per hour. Electrolytes every 2-3 hours. Magnesium 2x daily. Contaminated water accelerates via diarrhea.

platform._comment: All effects must run within Quest 3 thermal/power budget
